note_on_method: Each venue page rests on two City of Henderson records read in a browser on 2026-09-07, because cityofhenderson.com answers scripted requests with HTTP 403: the City's Pickleball page, whose Court Locations section is five small tables of facility name and "NUMBER OF COURTS", and either the City's Park Locations and Features directory or the centre's own page in the City's facility directory, which supply the address and an amenity list. The pickleball page states counts and no addresses; the directory and facility pages state addresses and no counts. A court is called outdoor or indoor only where the City's heading uses the word. Where the City is silent, these pages record the silence.

slots.description:
Eighteen outdoor pickleball courts at a City recreation centre, the largest count in Henderson and more than half of the city's 33 verified courts at one address.

The count is one row on the City's pickleball page, "Black Mountain Recreation Center 18", under the heading "OUTDOOR PICKLEBALL COURTS", so all eighteen publish as outdoor in the City's own word.

The City writes the site up twice. The centre's facility page describes "a 41,000 square foot facility" with a seasonal aquatic complex, a gymnasium, a fitness centre, racquetball and wallyball courts, tennis courts and a covered patio, and does not mention pickleball at all. The park directory lists the same address a second time as "Black Mountain Pickleball Park", with "Parking, Pickleball, Picnic Ramada, Picnic Tables, Playground, Restrooms" as its amenities.
slots.getting_there:
599 Greenway Rd., Henderson, NV 89015, in Clark County. The address is printed on the centre's own page in the City's facility directory and again in the park directory under "Black Mountain Pickleball Park".

This is the one Henderson venue where the City lists "Parking" as an amenity. Restrooms are on the same list. The facility page gives a phone number, (702) 267-4070, and no opening hours.
slots.what_to_expect:
Eighteen courts is a rotation at any hour, and enough for a tournament, which is one of the three uses the City names: courts can be reserved for a friendly game, a tournament or an event by calling the Sports Office at 702-267-5717. The page does not say what a reservation costs or whether the courts are free without one, so no price is recorded.

Hours are not stated for the courts or the centre. Lighting is not mentioned on any of the three City pages, so it is recorded as unknown and daylight is the plan. Surface is not stated. Whether any of the eighteen shares ground with the tennis courts the facility page lists is not stated either.

faqs.a: Eighteen, in one row on the City's pickleball page: "Black Mountain Recreation Center 18" under "OUTDOOR PICKLEBALL COURTS".
Not stated. Neither the pickleball page, the facility page nor the park directory mentions lighting, and no hours are published either.
Yes, by the City's park directory, which lists "Parking" among the amenities of "Black Mountain Pickleball Park" at this address, with restrooms, a picnic ramada and a playground.

slots.description:
Four pickleball courts at a City recreation centre, three of them indoor in the City's own word and the fourth on no stated side. These are the only indoor courts published in Henderson.

The City prints this centre twice on its pickleball page. "Silver Springs Recreation Center 3" sits under the heading "INDOOR PICKLEBALL COURTS", and "Silver Springs Recreation Center 1" sits under a fifth heading that reads only "PICKLEBALL COURTS" and says nothing about where that court is.

The centre's facility page is the other record. It describes "36,000 square feet" with a gymnasium, a dance room, racquetball and wallyball courts, a seasonal swimming pool and tennis courts, "Adjacent to Silver Springs Park", and does not mention pickleball at all.
